context: M9 o10. Penn Station concourse, under the Garden. Fireworks thud far away. They catch their breath.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: They came for the envelopes. Your fifty's in here.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Lonnie wants your job. Brannock wants you to look weak. Congratulations.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: I followed you. I wanted to see where my money sleeps.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Now you know. Thirty-First and Eighth, in a sergeant's glove box.

choices.text: Keep it. It's not mine to give.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Here. Tell Mayhew I lost it running. He'll believe it.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Rule six: nobody gives money back. You're breaking all my rules, Mr. Arce.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: It's not mine. That's the whole job. It's never mine.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Honest. In a way that doesn't help anybody. Okay.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Delphine. Since we've been shot at together. Well, almost.
